response.query: Does high audit quality (Big Four or industry-specialist auditors) moderate the relationship between military directors and earnings management?
response.answer: High audit quality from Big Four or industry-specialist auditors does moderate the relationship between military directors and earnings management, reducing the likelihood of earnings manipulation.
